verses.kjv: And the Lord came down upon mount Sinai, on the top of the mount: and the Lord called Moses up to the top of the mount; and Moses went up.

verses.web: Yahweh said to Moses, “Go down, warn the people, lest they break through to Yahweh to gaze, and many of them perish.
verses.kjv: And the Lord said unto Moses, Go down, charge the people, lest they break through unto the Lord to gaze, and many of them perish.

verses.web: Let the priests also, who come near to Yahweh, sanctify themselves, lest Yahweh break out on them.”
verses.kjv: And let the priests also, which come near to the Lord, sanctify themselves, lest the Lord break forth upon them.

verses.web: Moses said to Yahweh, “The people can’t come up to Mount Sinai, for you warned us, saying, ‘Set bounds around the mountain, and sanctify it.’”
verses.kjv: And Moses said unto the Lord, The people cannot come up to mount Sinai: for thou chargedst us, saying, Set bounds about the mount, and sanctify it.

verses.web: Yahweh said to him, “Go down! You shall bring Aaron up with you, but don’t let the priests and the people break through to come up to Yahweh, lest he break out against them.”
verses.kjv: And the Lord said unto him, Away, get thee down, and thou shalt come up, thou, and Aaron with thee: but let not the priests and the people break through to come up unto the Lord, lest he break forth upon them.

verses.web: So Moses went down to the people, and told them.
verses.kjv: So Moses went down unto the people, and spake unto them.

verses.web: God spoke all these words, saying,
verses.kjv: And God spake all these words, saying,

verses.web: “I am Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
verses.kjv: I am the Lord thy God, which have brought thee out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.

verses.web: “You shall have no other gods before me.
verses.kjv: Thou shalt have no other gods before me.

verses.web: “You shall not make for yourselves an idol, nor any image of anything that is in the heavens above, or that is in the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth:
verses.kjv: Thou shalt not make unto thee any graven image, or any likeness of any thing that is in heaven above, or that is in the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth:

verses.web: you shall not bow yourself down to them, nor serve them, for I, Yahweh your God, am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children, on the third and on the fourth generation of those who hate me,
verses.kjv: Thou shalt not bow down thyself to them, nor serve them: for I the Lord thy God am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation of them that hate me;

verses.web: and showing loving kindness to thousands of those who love me and keep my commandments.
verses.kjv: And shewing mercy unto thousands of them that love me, and keep my commandments.

verses.web: “You shall not take the name of Yahweh your God in vain, for Yahweh will not hold him guiltless who takes his name in vain.
verses.kjv: Thou shalt not take the name of the Lord thy God in vain; for the Lord will not hold him guiltless that taketh his name in vain.

verses.web: “Remember the Sabbath day, to keep it holy.
verses.kjv: Remember the sabbath day, to keep it holy.

verses.web: You shall labor six days, and do all your work,
verses.kjv: Six days shalt thou labour, and do all thy work:

verses.web: but the seventh day is a Sabbath to Yahweh your God. You shall not do any work in it, you, nor your son, nor your daughter, your male servant, nor your female servant, nor your livestock, nor your stranger who is within your gates;
verses.kjv: But the seventh day is the sabbath of the Lord thy God: in it thou shalt not do any work, thou, nor thy son, nor thy daughter, thy manservant, nor thy maidservant, nor thy cattle, nor thy stranger that is within thy gates:

verses.web: for in six days Yahweh made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that is in them, and rested the seventh day; therefore Yahweh blessed the Sabbath day, and made it holy.
verses.kjv: For in six days the Lord made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that in them is, and rested the seventh day: wherefore the Lord blessed the sabbath day, and hallowed it.

verses.web: “Honor your father and your mother, that your days may be long in the land which Yahweh your God gives you.
verses.kjv: Honour thy father and thy mother: that thy days may be long upon the land which the Lord thy God giveth thee.

verses.web: “You shall not murder.
verses.kjv: Thou shalt not kill.

verses.web: “You shall not commit adultery.
verses.kjv: Thou shalt not commit adultery.

verses.web: “You shall not steal.
verses.kjv: Thou shalt not steal.

verses.web: “You shall not give false testimony against your neighbor.
verses.kjv: Thou shalt not bear false witness against thy neighbour.

verses.web: “You shall not covet your neighbor’s house. You shall not covet your neighbor’s wife, nor his male servant, nor his female servant, nor his ox, nor his donkey, nor anything that is your neighbor’s.”
verses.kjv: Thou shalt not covet thy neighbour’s house, thou shalt not covet thy neighbour’s wife, nor his manservant, nor his maidservant, nor his ox, nor his ass, nor any thing that is thy neighbour’s.

verses.web: All the people perceived the thunderings, the lightnings, the sound of the trumpet, and the mountain smoking. When the people saw it, they trembled, and stayed at a distance.
verses.kjv: And all the people saw the thunderings, and the lightnings, and the noise of the trumpet, and the mountain smoking: and when the people saw it, they removed, and stood afar off.

verses.web: They said to Moses, “Speak with us yourself, and we will listen; but don’t let God speak with us, lest we die.”
verses.kjv: And they said unto Moses, Speak thou with us, and we will hear: but let not God speak with us, lest we die.

verses.web: Moses said to the people, “Don’t be afraid, for God has come to test you, and that his fear may be before you, that you won’t sin.”
verses.kjv: And Moses said unto the people, Fear not: for God is come to prove you, and that his fear may be before your faces, that ye sin not.

verses.web: The people stayed at a distance, and Moses drew near to the thick darkness where God was.
verses.kjv: And the people stood afar off, and Moses drew near unto the thick darkness where God was.

verses.web: Yahweh said to Moses, “This is what you shall tell the children of Israel: ‘You yourselves have seen that I have talked with you from heaven.
verses.kjv: And the Lord said unto Moses, Thus thou shalt say unto the children of Israel, Ye have seen that I have talked with you from heaven.

verses.web: You shall most certainly not make alongside of me gods of silver, or gods of gold for yourselves.
verses.kjv: Ye shall not make with me gods of silver, neither shall ye make unto you gods of gold.

verses.web: You shall make an altar of earth for me, and shall sacrifice on it your burnt offerings and your peace offerings, your sheep and your cattle. In every place where I record my name I will come to you and I will bless you.
verses.kjv: An altar of earth thou shalt make unto me, and shalt sacrifice thereon thy burnt offerings, and thy peace offerings, thy sheep, and thine oxen: in all places where I record my name I will come unto thee, and I will bless thee.

verses.web: If you make me an altar of stone, you shall not build it of cut stones; for if you lift up your tool on it, you have polluted it.
verses.kjv: And if thou wilt make me an altar of stone, thou shalt not build it of hewn stone: for if thou lift up thy tool upon it, thou hast polluted it.

verses.web: Neither shall you go up by steps to my altar, that your nakedness may not be exposed to it.’
verses.kjv: Neither shalt thou go up by steps unto mine altar, that thy nakedness be not discovered thereon.

verses.web: “Now these are the ordinances which you shall set before them.
verses.kjv: Now these are the judgments which thou shalt set before them.

verses.web: “If you buy a Hebrew servant, he shall serve six years and in the seventh he shall go out free without paying anything.
verses.kjv: If thou buy an Hebrew servant, six years he shall serve: and in the seventh he shall go out free for nothing.

verses.web: If he comes in by himself, he shall go out by himself. If he is married, then his wife shall go out with him.
verses.kjv: If he came in by himself, he shall go out by himself: if he were married, then his wife shall go out with him.

verses.web: If his master gives him a wife and she bears him sons or daughters, the wife and her children shall be her master’s, and he shall go out by himself.
verses.kjv: If his master have given him a wife, and she have born him sons or daughters; the wife and her children shall be her master’s, and he shall go out by himself.

verses.web: But if the servant shall plainly say, ‘I love my master, my wife, and my children. I will not go out free;’
verses.kjv: And if the servant shall plainly say, I love my master, my wife, and my children; I will not go out free:

verses.web: then his master shall bring him to God, and shall bring him to the door or to the doorpost, and his master shall bore his ear through with an awl, and he shall serve him for ever.
verses.kjv: Then his master shall bring him unto the judges; he shall also bring him to the door, or unto the door post; and his master shall bore his ear through with an aul; and he shall serve him for ever.

verses.web: “If a man sells his daughter to be a female servant, she shall not go out as the male servants do.
verses.kjv: And if a man sell his daughter to be a maidservant, she shall not go out as the menservants do.

verses.web: If she doesn’t please her master, who has married her to himself, then he shall let her be redeemed. He shall have no right to sell her to a foreign people, since he has dealt deceitfully with her.
verses.kjv: If she please not her master, who hath betrothed her to himself, then shall he let her be redeemed: to sell her unto a strange nation he shall have no power, seeing he hath dealt deceitfully with her.

verses.web: If he marries her to his son, he shall deal with her as a daughter.
verses.kjv: And if he have betrothed her unto his son, he shall deal with her after the manner of daughters.

verses.web: If he takes another wife to himself, he shall not diminish her food, her clothing, and her marital rights.
verses.kjv: If he take him another wife; her food, her raiment, and her duty of marriage, shall he not diminish.

verses.web: If he doesn’t do these three things for her, she may go free without paying any money.
verses.kjv: And if he do not these three unto her, then shall she go out free without money.

verses.web: “One who strikes a man so that he dies shall surely be put to death,
verses.kjv: He that smiteth a man, so that he die, shall be surely put to death.

verses.web: but not if it is unintentional, but God allows it to happen: then I will appoint you a place where he shall flee.
verses.kjv: And if a man lie not in wait, but God deliver him into his hand; then I will appoint thee a place whither he shall flee.

verses.web: If a man schemes and comes presumptuously on his neighbor to kill him, you shall take him from my altar, that he may die.
verses.kjv: But if a man come presumptuously upon his neighbour, to slay him with guile; thou shalt take him from mine altar, that he may die.

verses.web: “Anyone who attacks his father or his mother shall be surely put to death.
verses.kjv: And he that smiteth his father, or his mother, shall be surely put to death.

verses.web: “Anyone who kidnaps someone and sells him, or if he is found in his hand, he shall surely be put to death.
verses.kjv: And he that stealeth a man, and selleth him, or if he be found in his hand, he shall surely be put to death.

verses.web: “Anyone who curses his father or his mother shall surely be put to death.
verses.kjv: And he that curseth his father, or his mother, shall surely be put to death.

verses.web: “If men quarrel and one strikes the other with a stone, or with his fist, and he doesn’t die, but is confined to bed;
verses.kjv: And if men strive together, and one smite another with a stone, or with his fist, and he die not, but keepeth his bed:

verses.web: if he rises again and walks around with his staff, then he who struck him shall be cleared: only he shall pay for the loss of his time, and shall provide for his healing until he is thoroughly healed.
verses.kjv: If he rise again, and walk abroad upon his staff, then shall he that smote him be quit: only he shall pay for the loss of his time, and shall cause him to be thoroughly healed.

verses.web: “If a man strikes his servant or his maid with a rod, and he dies under his hand, he shall surely be punished.
verses.kjv: And if a man smite his servant, or his maid, with a rod, and he die under his hand; he shall be surely punished.

verses.web: Notwithstanding, if he gets up after a day or two, he shall not be punished, for he is his property.
verses.kjv: Notwithstanding, if he continue a day or two, he shall not be punished: for he is his money.

verses.web: “If men fight and hurt a pregnant woman so that she gives birth prematurely, and yet no harm follows, he shall be surely fined as much as the woman’s husband demands and the judges allow.
verses.kjv: If men strive, and hurt a woman with child, so that her fruit depart from her, and yet no mischief follow: he shall be surely punished, according as the woman’s husband will lay upon him; and he shall pay as the judges determine.

verses.web: But if any harm follows, then you must take life for life,
verses.kjv: And if any mischief follow, then thou shalt give life for life,

verses.web: eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot,
verses.kjv: Eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot,

verses.web: burning for burning, wound for wound, and bruise for bruise.
verses.kjv: Burning for burning, wound for wound, stripe for stripe.

verses.web: “If a man strikes his servant’s eye, or his maid’s eye, and destroys it, he shall let him go free for his eye’s sake.
verses.kjv: And if a man smite the eye of his servant, or the eye of his maid, that it perish; he shall let him go free for his eye’s sake.

verses.web: If he strikes out his male servant’s tooth, or his female servant’s tooth, he shall let him go free for his tooth’s sake.
verses.kjv: And if he smite out his manservant’s tooth, or his maidservant’s tooth; he shall let him go free for his tooth’s sake.

verses.web: “If a bull gores a man or a woman to death, the bull shall surely be stoned, and its flesh shall not be eaten; but the owner of the bull shall not be held responsible.
verses.kjv: If an ox gore a man or a woman, that they die: then the ox shall be surely stoned, and his flesh shall not be eaten; but the owner of the ox shall be quit.

verses.web: But if the bull had a habit of goring in the past, and it has been testified to its owner, and he has not kept it in, but it has killed a man or a woman, the bull shall be stoned, and its owner shall also be put to death.
verses.kjv: But if the ox were wont to push with his horn in time past, and it hath been testified to his owner, and he hath not kept him in, but that he hath killed a man or a woman; the ox shall be stoned, and his owner also shall be put to death.

verses.web: If a ransom is laid on him, then he shall give for the redemption of his life whatever is laid on him.
verses.kjv: If there be laid on him a sum of money, then he shall give for the ransom of his life whatsoever is laid upon him.

verses.web: Whether it has gored a son or has gored a daughter, according to this judgment it shall be done to him.
verses.kjv: Whether he have gored a son, or have gored a daughter, according to this judgment shall it be done unto him.

verses.web: If the bull gores a male servant or a female servant, thirty shekels of silver shall be given to their master, and the ox shall be stoned.
verses.kjv: If the ox shall push a manservant or a maidservant; he shall give unto their master thirty shekels of silver, and the ox shall be stoned.

verses.web: “If a man opens a pit, or if a man digs a pit and doesn’t cover it, and a bull or a donkey falls into it,
verses.kjv: And if a man shall open a pit, or if a man shall dig a pit, and not cover it, and an ox or an ass fall therein;

verses.web: the owner of the pit shall make it good. He shall give money to its owner, and the dead animal shall be his.
verses.kjv: The owner of the pit shall make it good, and give money unto the owner of them; and the dead beast shall be his.

verses.web: “If one man’s bull injures another’s, so that it dies, then they shall sell the live bull, and divide its price; and they shall also divide the dead animal.
verses.kjv: And if one man’s ox hurt another’s, that he die; then they shall sell the live ox, and divide the money of it; and the dead ox also they shall divide.

verses.web: Or if it is known that the bull was in the habit of goring in the past, and its owner has not kept it in, he shall surely pay bull for bull, and the dead animal shall be his own.
verses.kjv: Or if it be known that the ox hath used to push in time past, and his owner hath not kept him in; he shall surely pay ox for ox; and the dead shall be his own.

verses.web: “If a man steals an ox or a sheep, and kills it, or sells it; he shall pay five oxen for an ox, and four sheep for a sheep.
verses.kjv: If a man shall steal an ox, or a sheep, and kill it, or sell it; he shall restore five oxen for an ox, and four sheep for a sheep.

verses.web: If the thief is found breaking in, and is struck so that he dies, there shall be no guilt of bloodshed for him.
verses.kjv: If a thief be found breaking up, and be smitten that he die, there shall no blood be shed for him.

verses.web: If the sun has risen on him, guilt of bloodshed shall be for him; he shall make restitution. If he has nothing, then he shall be sold for his theft.
verses.kjv: If the sun be risen upon him, there shall be blood shed for him; for he should make full restitution; if he have nothing, then he shall be sold for his theft.

verses.web: If the stolen property is found in his hand alive, whether it is ox, donkey, or sheep, he shall pay double.
verses.kjv: If the theft be certainly found in his hand alive, whether it be ox, or ass, or sheep; he shall restore double.

verses.web: “If a man causes a field or vineyard to be eaten, and lets his animal loose, and it grazes in another man’s field, he shall make restitution from the best of his own field, and from the best of his own vineyard.
verses.kjv: If a man shall cause a field or vineyard to be eaten, and shall put in his beast, and shall feed in another man’s field; of the best of his own field, and of the best of his own vineyard, shall he make restitution.

verses.web: “If fire breaks out, and catches in thorns so that the shocks of grain, or the standing grain, or the field are consumed; he who kindled the fire shall surely make restitution.
verses.kjv: If fire break out, and catch in thorns, so that the stacks of corn, or the standing corn, or the field, be consumed therewith; he that kindled the fire shall surely make restitution.

verses.web: “If a man delivers to his neighbor money or stuff to keep, and it is stolen out of the man’s house; if the thief is found, he shall pay double.
verses.kjv: If a man shall deliver unto his neighbour money or stuff to keep, and it be stolen out of the man’s house; if the thief be found, let him pay double.

verses.web: If the thief isn’t found, then the master of the house shall come near to God, to find out if he hasn’t put his hand to his neighbor’s goods.
verses.kjv: If the thief be not found, then the master of the house shall be brought unto the judges, to see whether he have put his hand unto his neighbour’s goods.

verses.web: For every matter of trespass, whether it be for ox, for donkey, for sheep, for clothing, or for any kind of lost thing, about which one says, ‘This is mine,’ the cause of both parties shall come before God. He whom God condemns shall pay double to his neighbor.
verses.kjv: For all manner of trespass, whether it be for ox, for ass, for sheep, for raiment, or for any manner of lost thing, which another challengeth to be his, the cause of both parties shall come before the judges; and whom the judges shall condemn, he shall pay double unto his neighbour.

verses.web: “If a man delivers to his neighbor a donkey, an ox, a sheep, or any animal to keep, and it dies or is injured, or driven away, no man seeing it;
verses.kjv: If a man deliver unto his neighbour an ass, or an ox, or a sheep, or any beast, to keep; and it die, or be hurt, or driven away, no man seeing it:

verses.web: the oath of Yahweh shall be between them both, whether he hasn’t put his hand to his neighbor’s goods; and its owner shall accept it, and he shall not make restitution.
verses.kjv: Then shall an oath of the Lord be between them both, that he hath not put his hand unto his neighbour’s goods; and the owner of it shall accept thereof, and he shall not make it good.

verses.web: But if it is stolen from him, he shall make restitution to its owner.
verses.kjv: And if it be stolen from him, he shall make restitution unto the owner thereof.

verses.web: If it is torn in pieces, let him bring it for evidence. He shall not make good that which was torn.
verses.kjv: If it be torn in pieces, then let him bring it for witness, and he shall not make good that which was torn.

verses.web: “If a man borrows anything of his neighbor’s, and it is injured, or dies, its owner not being with it, he shall surely make restitution.
verses.kjv: And if a man borrow ought of his neighbour, and it be hurt, or die, the owner thereof being not with it, he shall surely make it good.

verses.web: If its owner is with it, he shall not make it good. If it is a leased thing, it came for its lease.
verses.kjv: But if the owner thereof be with it, he shall not make it good: if it be an hired thing, it came for his hire.

verses.web: “If a man entices a virgin who isn’t pledged to be married, and lies with her, he shall surely pay a dowry for her to be his wife.
verses.kjv: And if a man entice a maid that is not betrothed, and lie with her, he shall surely endow her to be his wife.

verses.web: If her father utterly refuses to give her to him, he shall pay money according to the dowry of virgins.
verses.kjv: If her father utterly refuse to give her unto him, he shall pay money according to the dowry of virgins.

verses.web: “You shall not allow a sorceress to live.
verses.kjv: Thou shalt not suffer a witch to live.

verses.web: “Whoever has sex with an animal shall surely be put to death.
verses.kjv: Whosoever lieth with a beast shall surely be put to death.

verses.web: “He who sacrifices to any god, except to Yahweh only, shall be utterly destroyed.
verses.kjv: He that sacrificeth unto any god, save unto the Lord only, he shall be utterly destroyed.

verses.web: “You shall not wrong an alien, neither shall you oppress him, for you were aliens in the land of Egypt.
verses.kjv: Thou shalt neither vex a stranger, nor oppress him: for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.

verses.web: “You shall not take advantage of any widow or fatherless child.
verses.kjv: Ye shall not afflict any widow, or fatherless child.

verses.web: If you take advantage of them at all, and they cry at all to me, I will surely hear their cry;
verses.kjv: If thou afflict them in any wise, and they cry at all unto me, I will surely hear their cry;

verses.web: and my wrath will grow hot, and I will kill you with the sword; and your wives shall be widows, and your children fatherless.
verses.kjv: And my wrath shall wax hot, and I will kill you with the sword; and your wives shall be widows, and your children fatherless.

verses.web: “If you lend money to any of my people with you who is poor, you shall not be to him as a creditor; neither shall you charge him interest.
verses.kjv: If thou lend money to any of my people that is poor by thee, thou shalt not be to him as an usurer, neither shalt thou lay upon him usury.

verses.web: If you take your neighbor’s garment as collateral, you shall restore it to him before the sun goes down,
verses.kjv: If thou at all take thy neighbour’s raiment to pledge, thou shalt deliver it unto him by that the sun goeth down:

verses.web: for that is his only covering, it is his garment for his skin. What would he sleep in? It will happen, when he cries to me, that I will hear, for I am gracious.
verses.kjv: For that is his covering only, it is his raiment for his skin: wherein shall he sleep? and it shall come to pass, when he crieth unto me, that I will hear; for I am gracious.

verses.web: “You shall not blaspheme God, nor curse a ruler of your people.
verses.kjv: Thou shalt not revile the gods, nor curse the ruler of thy people.

verses.web: “You shall not delay to offer from your harvest and from the outflow of your presses. “You shall give the firstborn of your sons to me.
verses.kjv: Thou shalt not delay to offer the first of thy ripe fruits, and of thy liquors: the firstborn of thy sons shalt thou give unto me.

verses.web: You shall do likewise with your cattle and with your sheep. Seven days it shall be with its mother, then on the eighth day you shall give it to me.
verses.kjv: Likewise shalt thou do with thine oxen, and with thy sheep: seven days it shall be with his dam; on the eighth day thou shalt give it me.

verses.web: “You shall be holy men to me, therefore you shall not eat any flesh that is torn by animals in the field. You shall cast it to the dogs.
verses.kjv: And ye shall be holy men unto me: neither shall ye eat any flesh that is torn of beasts in the field; ye shall cast it to the dogs.

verses.web: “You shall not spread a false report. Don’t join your hand with the wicked to be a malicious witness.
verses.kjv: Thou shalt not raise a false report: put not thine hand with the wicked to be an unrighteous witness.

verses.web: “You shall not follow a crowd to do evil; neither shall you testify in court to side with a multitude to pervert justice;
verses.kjv: Thou shalt not follow a multitude to do evil; neither shalt thou speak in a cause to decline after many to wrest judgment:

verses.web: neither shall you favor a poor man in his cause.
verses.kjv: Neither shalt thou countenance a poor man in his cause.

verses.web: “If you meet your enemy’s ox or his donkey going astray, you shall surely bring it back to him again.
verses.kjv: If thou meet thine enemy’s ox or his ass going astray, thou shalt surely bring it back to him again.

verses.web: If you see the donkey of him who hates you fallen down under his burden, don’t leave him, you shall surely help him with it.
verses.kjv: If thou see the ass of him that hateth thee lying under his burden, and wouldest forbear to help him, thou shalt surely help with him.

verses.web: “You shall not deny justice to your poor people in their lawsuits.
verses.kjv: Thou shalt not wrest the judgment of thy poor in his cause.

verses.web: “Keep far from a false charge, and don’t kill the innocent and righteous: for I will not justify the wicked.
verses.kjv: Keep thee far from a false matter; and the innocent and righteous slay thou not: for I will not justify the wicked.

verses.web: “You shall take no bribe, for a bribe blinds those who have sight and perverts the words of the righteous.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt take no gift: for the gift blindeth the wise, and perverteth the words of the righteous.

verses.web: “You shall not oppress an alien, for you know the heart of an alien, since you were aliens in the land of Egypt.
verses.kjv: Also thou shalt not oppress a stranger: for ye know the heart of a stranger, seeing ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.

verses.web: “For six years you shall sow your land, and shall gather in its increase,
verses.kjv: And six years thou shalt sow thy land, and shalt gather in the fruits thereof:

verses.web: but the seventh year you shall let it rest and lie fallow, that the poor of your people may eat; and what they leave the animal of the field shall eat. In the same way, you shall deal with your vineyard and with your olive grove.
verses.kjv: But the seventh year thou shalt let it rest and lie still; that the poor of thy people may eat: and what they leave the beasts of the field shall eat. In like manner thou shalt deal with thy vineyard, and with thy oliveyard.

verses.web: “Six days you shall do your work, and on the seventh day you shall rest, that your ox and your donkey may have rest, and the son of your handmaid, and the alien may be refreshed.
verses.kjv: Six days thou shalt do thy work, and on the seventh day thou shalt rest: that thine ox and thine ass may rest, and the son of thy handmaid, and the stranger, may be refreshed.

verses.web: “Be careful to do all things that I have said to you; and don’t invoke the name of other gods, neither let them be heard out of your mouth.
verses.kjv: And in all things that I have said unto you be circumspect: and make no mention of the name of other gods, neither let it be heard out of thy mouth.

verses.web: “You shall observe a feast to me three times a year.
verses.kjv: Three times thou shalt keep a feast unto me in the year.

verses.web: You shall observe the feast of unleavened bread. Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, as I commanded you, at the time appointed in the month Abib (for in it you came out of Egypt), and no one shall appear before me empty.
verses.kjv: Thou shalt keep the feast of unleavened bread: (thou shalt eat unleavened bread seven days, as I commanded thee, in the time appointed of the month Abib; for in it thou camest out from Egypt: and none shall appear before me empty:)

verses.web: And the feast of harvest, the first fruits of your labors, which you sow in the field; and the feast of ingathering, at the end of the year, when you gather in your labors out of the field.
verses.kjv: And the feast of harvest, the firstfruits of thy labours, which thou hast sown in the field: and the feast of ingathering, which is in the end of the year, when thou hast gathered in thy labours out of the field.

verses.web: Three times in the year all your males shall appear before the Lord Yahweh.
verses.kjv: Three times in the year all thy males shall appear before the Lord God.

verses.web: “You shall not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread, neither shall the fat of my feast remain all night until the morning.
verses.kjv: Thou shalt not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread; neither shall the fat of my sacrifice remain until the morning.

verses.web: The first of the first fruits of your ground you shall bring into the house of Yahweh your God. “You shall not boil a young goat in its mother’s milk.
verses.kjv: The first of the firstfruits of thy land thou shalt bring into the house of the Lord thy God. Thou shalt not seethe a kid in his mother’s milk.

verses.web: “Behold, I send an angel before you, to keep you by the way, and to bring you into the place which I have prepared.
verses.kjv: Behold, I send an Angel before thee, to keep thee in the way, and to bring thee into the place which I have prepared.

verses.web: Pay attention to him, and listen to his voice. Don’t provoke him, for he will not pardon your disobedience, for my name is in him.
verses.kjv: Beware of him, and obey his voice, provoke him not; for he will not pardon your transgressions: for my name is in him.

verses.web: But if you indeed listen to his voice, and do all that I speak, then I will be an enemy to your enemies, and an adversary to your adversaries.
verses.kjv: But if thou shalt indeed obey his voice, and do all that I speak; then I will be an enemy unto thine enemies, and an adversary unto thine adversaries.

verses.web: For my angel shall go before you, and bring you in to the Amorite, the Hittite, the Perizzite, the Canaanite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite; and I will cut them off.
verses.kjv: For mine Angel shall go before thee, and bring thee in unto the Amorites, and the Hittites, and the Perizzites, and the Canaanites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites: and I will cut them off.

verses.web: You shall not bow down to their gods, nor serve them, nor follow their practices, but you shall utterly overthrow them and demolish their pillars.
verses.kjv: Thou shalt not bow down to their gods, nor serve them, nor do after their works: but thou shalt utterly overthrow them, and quite break down their images.

verses.web: You shall serve Yahweh your God, and he will bless your bread and your water, and I will take sickness away from your midst.
verses.kjv: And ye shall serve the Lord your God, and he shall bless thy bread, and thy water; and I will take sickness away from the midst of thee.

verses.web: No one will miscarry or be barren in your land. I will fulfill the number of your days.
verses.kjv: There shall nothing cast their young, nor be barren, in thy land: the number of thy days I will fulfil.

verses.web: I will send my terror before you, and will confuse all the people to whom you come, and I will make all your enemies turn their backs to you.
verses.kjv: I will send my fear before thee, and will destroy all the people to whom thou shalt come, and I will make all thine enemies turn their backs unto thee.

verses.web: I will send the hornet before you, which will drive out the Hivite, the Canaanite, and the Hittite, from before you.
verses.kjv: And I will send hornets before thee, which shall drive out the Hivite, the Canaanite, and the Hittite, from before thee.

verses.web: I will not drive them out from before you in one year, lest the land become desolate, and the animals of the field multiply against you.
verses.kjv: I will not drive them out from before thee in one year; lest the land become desolate, and the beast of the field multiply against thee.

verses.web: Little by little I will drive them out from before you, until you have increased and inherit the land.
verses.kjv: By little and little I will drive them out from before thee, until thou be increased, and inherit the land.

verses.web: I will set your border from the Red Sea even to the sea of the Philistines, and from the wilderness to the River; for I will deliver the inhabitants of the land into your hand, and you shall drive them out before you.
verses.kjv: And I will set thy bounds from the Red sea even unto the sea of the Philistines, and from the desert unto the river: for I will deliver the inhabitants of the land into your hand; and thou shalt drive them out before thee.

verses.web: You shall make no covenant with them, nor with their gods.
verses.kjv: Thou shalt make no covenant with them, nor with their gods.

verses.web: They shall not dwell in your land, lest they make you sin against me, for if you serve their gods, it will surely be a snare to you.”
verses.kjv: They shall not dwell in thy land, lest they make thee sin against me: for if thou serve their gods, it will surely be a snare unto thee.

verses.web: He said to Moses, “Come up to Yahweh, you, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel; and worship from a distance.
verses.kjv: And he said unto Moses, Come up unto the Lord, thou, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel; and worship ye afar off.

verses.web: Moses alone shall come near to Yahweh, but they shall not come near, neither shall the people go up with him.”
verses.kjv: And Moses alone shall come near the Lord: but they shall not come nigh; neither shall the people go up with him.

verses.web: Moses came and told the people all Yahweh’s words, and all the ordinances; and all the people answered with one voice, and said, “All the words which Yahweh has spoken will we do.”
verses.kjv: And Moses came and told the people all the words of the Lord, and all the judgments: and all the people answered with one voice, and said, All the words which the Lord hath said will we do.

verses.web: Moses wrote all Yahweh’s words, and rose up early in the morning, and built an altar under the mountain, and twelve pillars for the twelve tribes of Israel.
verses.kjv: And Moses wrote all the words of the Lord, and rose up early in the morning, and builded an altar under the hill, and twelve pillars, according to the twelve tribes of Israel.

verses.web: He sent young men of the children of Israel, who offered burnt offerings and sacrificed peace offerings of cattle to Yahweh.
verses.kjv: And he sent young men of the children of Israel, which offered burnt offerings, and sacrificed peace offerings of oxen unto the Lord.

verses.web: Moses took half of the blood and put it in basins, and half of the blood he sprinkled on the altar.
verses.kjv: And Moses took half of the blood, and put it in basons; and half of the blood he sprinkled on the altar.

verses.web: He took the book of the covenant and read it in the hearing of the people, and they said, “All that Yahweh has spoken will we do, and be obedient.”
verses.kjv: And he took the book of the covenant, and read in the audience of the people: and they said, All that the Lord hath said will we do, and be obedient.

verses.web: Moses took the blood, and sprinkled it on the people, and said, “Look, this is the blood of the covenant, which Yahweh has made with you concerning all these words.”
verses.kjv: And Moses took the blood, and sprinkled it on the people, and said, Behold the blood of the covenant, which the Lord hath made with you concerning all these words.

verses.web: Then Moses, Aaron, Nadab, Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel went up.
verses.kjv: Then went up Moses, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel:

verses.web: They saw the God of Israel. Under his feet was like a paved work of sapphire stone, like the skies for clearness.
verses.kjv: And they saw the God of Israel: and there was under his feet as it were a paved work of a sapphire stone, and as it were the body of heaven in his clearness.

verses.web: He didn’t lay his hand on the nobles of the children of Israel. They saw God, and ate and drank.
verses.kjv: And upon the nobles of the children of Israel he laid not his hand: also they saw God, and did eat and drink.

verses.web: Yahweh said to Moses, “Come up to me on the mountain, and stay here, and I will give you the stone tablets with the law and the commands that I have written, that you may teach them.”
verses.kjv: And the Lord said unto Moses, Come up to me into the mount, and be there: and I will give thee tables of stone, and a law, and commandments which I have written; that thou mayest teach them.

verses.web: Moses rose up with Joshua, his servant, and Moses went up onto God’s Mountain.
verses.kjv: And Moses rose up, and his minister Joshua: and Moses went up into the mount of God.

verses.web: He said to the elders, “Wait here for us, until we come again to you. Behold, Aaron and Hur are with you. Whoever is involved in a dispute can go to them.”
verses.kjv: And he said unto the elders, Tarry ye here for us, until we come again unto you: and, behold, Aaron and Hur are with you: if any man have any matters to do, let him come unto them.

verses.web: Moses went up on the mountain, and the cloud covered the mountain.
verses.kjv: And Moses went up into the mount, and a cloud covered the mount.

verses.web: Yahweh’s glory settled on Mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it six days. The seventh day he called to Moses out of the midst of the cloud.
verses.kjv: And the glory of the Lord abode upon mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it six days: and the seventh day he called unto Moses out of the midst of the cloud.

verses.web: The appearance of Yahweh’s glory was like devouring fire on the top of the mountain in the eyes of the children of Israel.
verses.kjv: And the sight of the glory of the Lord was like devouring fire on the top of the mount in the eyes of the children of Israel.

verses.web: Moses entered into the midst of the cloud, and went up on the mountain; and Moses was on the mountain forty days and forty nights.
verses.kjv: And Moses went into the midst of the cloud, and gat him up into the mount: and Moses was in the mount forty days and forty nights.

verses.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.web: “Speak to the children of Israel, that they take an offering for me. From everyone whose heart makes him willing you shall take my offering.
verses.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, that they bring me an offering: of every man that giveth it willingly with his heart ye shall take my offering.

verses.web: This is the offering which you shall take from them: gold, silver, brass,
verses.kjv: And this is the offering which ye shall take of them; gold, and silver, and brass,

verses.web: blue, purple, scarlet, fine linen, goats’ hair,
verses.kjv: And blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats’ hair,

verses.web: rams’ skins dyed red, sea cow hides, acacia wood,
verses.kjv: And rams’ skins dyed red, and badgers’ skins, and shittim wood,

verses.web: oil for the light, spices for the anointing oil and for the sweet incense,
verses.kjv: Oil for the light, spices for anointing oil, and for sweet incense,

verses.web: onyx stones, and stones to be set for the ephod and for the breastplate.
verses.kjv: Onyx stones, and stones to be set in the ephod, and in the breastplate.

verses.web: Let them make me a sanctuary, that I may dwell among them.
verses.kjv: And let them make me a sanctuary; that I may dwell among them.

verses.web: According to all that I show you, the pattern of the tabernacle, and the pattern of all of its furniture, even so you shall make it.
verses.kjv: According to all that I shew thee, after the pattern of the tabernacle, and the pattern of all the instruments thereof, even so shall ye make it.

verses.web: “They shall make an ark of acacia wood. Its length shall be two and a half cubits, its breadth a cubit and a half, and a cubit and a half its height.
verses.kjv: And they shall make an ark of shittim wood: two cubits and a half shall be the length thereof, and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof.

verses.web: You shall overlay it with pure gold. You shall overlay it inside and outside, and you shall make a gold molding around it.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, within and without shalt thou overlay it, and shalt make upon it a crown of gold round about.

verses.web: You shall cast four rings of gold for it, and put them in its four feet. Two rings shall be on the one side of it, and two rings on the other side of it.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt cast four rings of gold for it, and put them in the four corners thereof; and two rings shall be in the one side of it, and two rings in the other side of it.

verses.web: You shall make poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt make staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold.

verses.web: You shall put the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark to carry the ark.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt put the staves into the rings by the sides of the ark, that the ark may be borne with them.

verses.web: The poles shall be in the rings of the ark. They shall not be taken from it.
verses.kjv: The staves shall be in the rings of the ark: they shall not be taken from it.

verses.web: You shall put the testimony which I shall give you into the ark.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt put into the ark the testimony which I shall give thee.

verses.web: You shall make a mercy seat of pure gold. Two and a half cubits shall be its length, and a cubit and a half its breadth.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt make a mercy seat of pure gold: two cubits and a half shall be the length thereof, and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof.

verses.web: You shall make two cherubim of hammered gold. You shall make them at the two ends of the mercy seat.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt make two cherubims of gold, of beaten work shalt thou make them, in the two ends of the mercy seat.

verses.web: Make one cherub at the one end, and one cherub at the other end. You shall make the cherubim on its two ends of one piece with the mercy seat.
verses.kjv: And make one cherub on the one end, and the other cherub on the other end: even of the mercy seat shall ye make the cherubims on the two ends thereof.

verses.web: The cherubim shall spread out their wings upward, covering the mercy seat with their wings, with their faces toward one another. The faces of the cherubim shall be toward the mercy seat.
verses.kjv: And the cherubims shall stretch forth their wings on high, covering the mercy seat with their wings, and their faces shall look one to another; toward the mercy seat shall the faces of the cherubims be.

verses.web: You shall put the mercy seat on top of the ark, and in the ark you shall put the testimony that I will give you.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt put the mercy seat above upon the ark; and in the ark thou shalt put the testimony that I shall give thee.

verses.web: There I will meet with you, and I will tell you from above the mercy seat, from between the two cherubim which are on the ark of the testimony, all that I command you for the children of Israel.
verses.kjv: And there I will meet with thee, and I will commune with thee from above the mercy seat, from between the two cherubims which are upon the ark of the testimony, of all things which I will give thee in commandment unto the children of Israel.

verses.web: “You shall make a table of acacia wood. Two cubits shall be its length, and a cubit its breadth, and one and a half cubits its height.
verses.kjv: Thou shalt also make a table of shittim wood: two cubits shall be the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof.

verses.web: You shall overlay it with pure gold, and make a gold molding around it.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, and make thereto a crown of gold round about.

verses.web: You shall make a rim of a hand breadth around it. You shall make a golden molding on its rim around it.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt make unto it a border of an hand breadth round about, and thou shalt make a golden crown to the border thereof round about.

verses.web: You shall make four rings of gold for it, and put the rings in the four corners that are on its four feet.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt make for it four rings of gold, and put the rings in the four corners that are on the four feet thereof.

verses.web: the rings shall be close to the rim, for places for the poles to carry the table.
verses.kjv: Over against the border shall the rings be for places of the staves to bear the table.

verses.web: You shall make the poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold, that the table may be carried with them.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt make the staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold, that the table may be borne with them.

verses.web: You shall make its dishes, its spoons, its ladles, and its bowls to pour out offerings with. You shall make them of pure gold.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt make the dishes thereof, and spoons thereof, and covers thereof, and bowls thereof, to cover withal: of pure gold shalt thou make them.

verses.web: You shall set bread of the presence on the table before me always.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt set upon the table shewbread before me alway.

verses.web: “You shall make a lamp stand of pure gold. Of hammered work shall the lamp stand be made, even its base, its shaft, its cups, its buds, and its flowers, shall be of one piece with it.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt make a candlestick of pure gold: of beaten work shall the candlestick be made: his shaft, and his branches, his bowls, his knops, and his flowers, shall be of the same.

verses.web: There shall be six branches going out of its sides: three branches of the lamp stand out of its one side, and three branches of the lamp stand out of its other side;
verses.kjv: And six branches shall come out of the sides of it; three branches of the candlestick out of the one side, and three branches of the candlestick out of the other side:

verses.web: three cups made like almond blossoms in one branch, a bud and a flower; and three cups made like almond blossoms in the other branch, a bud and a flower, so for the six branches going out of the lamp stand;
verses.kjv: Three bowls made like unto almonds, with a knop and a flower in one branch; and three bowls made like almonds in the other branch, with a knop and a flower: so in the six branches that come out of the candlestick.

verses.web: and in the lamp stand four cups made like almond blossoms, its buds and its flowers;
verses.kjv: And in the candlestick shall be four bowls made like unto almonds, with their knops and their flowers.

verses.web: and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, for the six branches going out of the lamp stand.
verses.kjv: And there shall be a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, according to the six branches that proceed out of the candlestick.

verses.web: Their buds and their branches shall be of one piece with it, all of it one beaten work of pure gold.
verses.kjv: Their knops and their branches shall be of the same: all it shall be one beaten work of pure gold.

verses.web: You shall make its lamps seven, and they shall light its lamps to give light to the space in front of it.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt make the seven lamps thereof: and they shall light the lamps thereof, that they may give light over against it.

verses.web: Its snuffers and its snuff dishes shall be of pure gold.
verses.kjv: And the tongs thereof, and the snuffdishes thereof, shall be of pure gold.

verses.web: It shall be made of a talent of pure gold, with all these accessories.
verses.kjv: Of a talent of pure gold shall he make it, with all these vessels.

verses.web: See that you make them after their pattern, which has been shown to you on the mountain.
verses.kjv: And look that thou make them after their pattern, which was shewed thee in the mount.

verses.web: “Moreover you shall make the tabernacle with ten curtains; of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, with cherubim. The work of the skillful workman you shall make them.
verses.kjv: Moreover thou shalt make the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet: with cherubims of cunning work shalt thou make them.

verses.web: The length of each curtain shall be twenty-eight cubits, and the breadth of each curtain four cubits: all the curtains shall have one measure.
verses.kjv: The length of one curtain shall be eight and twenty cubits, and the breadth of one curtain four cubits: and every one of the curtains shall have one measure.

verses.web: Five curtains shall be coupled together one to another; and the other five curtains shall be coupled one to another.
verses.kjv: The five curtains shall be coupled together one to another; and other five curtains shall be coupled one to another.

verses.web: You shall make loops of blue on the edge of the one curtain from the edge in the coupling; and likewise you shall make in the edge of the curtain that is outermost in the second coupling.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt make loops of blue upon the edge of the one curtain from the selvedge in the coupling; and likewise shalt thou make in the uttermost edge of another curtain, in the coupling of the second.

verses.web: You shall make fifty loops in the one curtain, and you shall make fifty loops in the edge of the curtain that is in the second coupling. The loops shall be opposite one to another.
verses.kjv: Fifty loops shalt thou make in the one curtain, and fifty loops shalt thou make in the edge of the curtain that is in the coupling of the second; that the loops may take hold one of another.

verses.web: You shall make fifty clasps of gold, and couple the curtains one to another with the clasps: and the tabernacle shall be a unit.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt make fifty taches of gold, and couple the curtains together with the taches: and it shall be one tabernacle.

verses.web: “You shall make curtains of goats’ hair for a covering over the tabernacle. You shall make them eleven curtains.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt make curtains of goats’ hair to be a covering upon the tabernacle: eleven curtains shalt thou make.

verses.web: The length of each curtain shall be thirty cubits, and the breadth of each curtain four cubits: the eleven curtains shall have one measure.
verses.kjv: The length of one curtain shall be thirty cubits, and the breadth of one curtain four cubits: and the eleven curtains shall be all of one measure.

verses.web: You shall couple five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves, and shall double over the sixth curtain in the forefront of the tent.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt couple five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves, and shalt double the sixth curtain in the forefront of the tabernacle.

verses.web: You shall make fifty loops on the edge of the one curtain that is outermost in the coupling, and fifty loops on the edge of the curtain which is outermost in the second coupling.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt make fifty loops on the edge of the one curtain that is outmost in the coupling, and fifty loops in the edge of the curtain which coupleth the second.

verses.web: You shall make fifty clasps of brass, and put the clasps into the loops, and couple the tent together, that it may be one.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt make fifty taches of brass, and put the taches into the loops, and couple the tent together, that it may be one.

verses.web: The overhanging part that remains of the curtains of the tent, the half curtain that remains, shall hang over the back of the tabernacle.
verses.kjv: And the remnant that remaineth of the curtains of the tent, the half curtain that remaineth, shall hang over the backside of the tabernacle.

verses.web: The cubit on the one side, and the cubit on the other side, of that which remains in the length of the curtains of the tent, shall hang over the sides of the tabernacle on this side and on that side, to cover it.
verses.kjv: And a cubit on the one side, and a cubit on the other side of that which remaineth in the length of the curtains of the tent, it shall hang over the sides of the tabernacle on this side and on that side, to cover it.

verses.web: You shall make a covering for the tent of rams’ skins dyed red, and a covering of sea cow hides above.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt make a covering for the tent of rams’ skins dyed red, and a covering above of badgers’ skins.

verses.web: “You shall make the boards for the tabernacle of acacia wood, standing up.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt make boards for the tabernacle of shittim wood standing up.

verses.web: Ten cubits shall be the length of a board, and one and a half cubits the breadth of each board.
verses.kjv: Ten cubits shall be the length of a board, and a cubit and a half shall be the breadth of one board.

verses.web: There shall be two tenons in each board, joined to one another: thus you shall make for all the boards of the tabernacle.
verses.kjv: Two tenons shall there be in one board, set in order one against another: thus shalt thou make for all the boards of the tabernacle.

verses.web: You shall make the boards for the tabernacle, twenty boards for the south side southward.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt make the boards for the tabernacle, twenty boards on the south side southward.

verses.web: You shall make forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards; two sockets under one board for its two tenons, and two sockets under another board for its two tenons.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt make forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards; two sockets under one board for his two tenons, and two sockets under another board for his two tenons.

verses.web: For the second side of the tabernacle, on the north side, twenty boards,
verses.kjv: And for the second side of the tabernacle on the north side there shall be twenty boards:

verses.web: and their forty sockets of silver; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.
verses.kjv: And their forty sockets of silver; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.

verses.web: For the far part of the tabernacle westward you shall make six boards.
verses.kjv: And for the sides of the tabernacle westward thou shalt make six boards.

verses.web: You shall make two boards for the corners of the tabernacle in the far part.
verses.kjv: And two boards shalt thou make for the corners of the tabernacle in the two sides.

verses.web: They shall be double beneath, and in the same way they shall be whole to its top to one ring: thus shall it be for them both; they shall be for the two corners.
verses.kjv: And they shall be coupled together beneath, and they shall be coupled together above the head of it unto one ring: thus shall it be for them both; they shall be for the two corners.

verses.web: There shall be eight boards, and their sockets of silver, sixteen sockets; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.
verses.kjv: And they shall be eight boards, and their sockets of silver, sixteen sockets; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.

verses.web: “You shall make bars of acacia wood: five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,
verses.kjv: And thou shalt make bars of shittim wood; five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,

verses.web: and five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the side of the tabernacle, for the far part westward.
verses.kjv: And five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the side of the tabernacle, for the two sides westward.

verses.web: The middle bar in the midst of the boards shall pass through from end to end.
verses.kjv: And the middle bar in the midst of the boards shall reach from end to end.

verses.web: You shall overlay the boards with gold, and make their rings of gold for places for the bars: and you shall overlay the bars with gold.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt overlay the boards with gold, and make their rings of gold for places for the bars: and thou shalt overlay the bars with gold.

verses.web: You shall set up the tabernacle according to the way that it was shown to you on the mountain.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt rear up the tabernacle according to the fashion thereof which was shewed thee in the mount.

verses.web: “You shall make a veil of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, with cherubim. The work of the skillful workman shall it be made.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt make a vail of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen of cunning work: with cherubims shall it be made:

verses.web: You shall hang it on four pillars of acacia overlaid with gold; their hooks shall be of gold, on four sockets of silver.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt hang it upon four pillars of shittim wood overlaid with gold: their hooks shall be of gold, upon the four sockets of silver.

verses.web: You shall hang up the veil under the clasps, and shall bring the ark of the testimony in there within the veil: and the veil shall separate the holy place from the most holy for you.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt hang up the vail under the taches, that thou mayest bring in thither within the vail the ark of the testimony: and the vail shall divide unto you between the holy place and the most holy.

verses.web: You shall put the mercy seat on the ark of the testimony in the most holy place.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt put the mercy seat upon the ark of the testimony in the most holy place.

verses.web: You shall set the table outside the veil, and the lamp stand over against the table on the side of the tabernacle toward the south: and you shall put the table on the north side.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt set the table without the vail, and the candlestick over against the table on the side of the tabernacle toward the south: and thou shalt put the table on the north side.

verses.web: “You shall make a screen for the door of the Tent, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of the embroiderer.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt make an hanging for the door of the tent, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, wrought with needlework.

verses.web: You shall make for the screen five pillars of acacia, and overlay them with gold: their hooks shall be of gold: and you shall cast five sockets of brass for them.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt make for the hanging five pillars of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold, and their hooks shall be of gold: and thou shalt cast five sockets of brass for them.

verses.web: “You shall make the altar of acacia wood, five cubits long, and five cubits broad; the altar shall be square: and its height shall be three cubits.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt make an altar of shittim wood, five cubits long, and five cubits broad; the altar shall be foursquare: and the height thereof shall be three cubits.

verses.web: You shall make its horns on its four corners; its horns shall be of one piece with it; and you shall overlay it with brass.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt make the horns of it upon the four corners thereof: his horns shall be of the same: and thou shalt overlay it with brass.

verses.web: You shall make its pots to take away its ashes, its shovels, its basins, its flesh hooks, and its fire pans: all its vessels you shall make of brass.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt make his pans to receive his ashes, and his shovels, and his basons, and his fleshhooks, and his firepans: all the vessels thereof thou shalt make of brass.

verses.web: You shall make a grating for it of network of brass: and on the net you shall make four bronze rings in its four corners.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt make for it a grate of network of brass; and upon the net shalt thou make four brasen rings in the four corners thereof.

verses.web: You shall put it under the ledge around the altar beneath, that the net may reach halfway up the altar.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt put it under the compass of the altar beneath, that the net may be even to the midst of the altar.

verses.web: You shall make poles for the altar, poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with brass.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt make staves for the altar, staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with brass.

verses.web: Its poles shall be put into the rings, and the poles shall be on the two sides of the altar, when carrying it.
verses.kjv: And the staves shall be put into the rings, and the staves shall be upon the two sides of the altar, to bear it.

verses.web: You shall make it with hollow planks. They shall make it as it has been shown you on the mountain.
verses.kjv: Hollow with boards shalt thou make it: as it was shewed thee in the mount, so shall they make it.

verses.web: “You shall make the court of the tabernacle: for the south side southward there shall be hangings for the court of fine twined linen one hundred cubits long for one side:
verses.kjv: And thou shalt make the court of the tabernacle: for the south side southward there shall be hangings for the court of fine twined linen of an hundred cubits long for one side:

verses.web: and its pillars shall be twenty, and their sockets twenty, of brass; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets shall be of silver.
verses.kjv: And the twenty pillars thereof and their twenty sockets shall be of brass; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets shall be of silver.

verses.web: Likewise for the north side in length there shall be hangings one hundred cubits long, and its pillars twenty, and their sockets twenty, of brass; the hooks of the pillars, and their fillets, of silver.
verses.kjv: And likewise for the north side in length there shall be hangings of an hundred cubits long, and his twenty pillars and their twenty sockets of brass; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver.

verses.web: For the breadth of the court on the west side shall be hangings of fifty cubits; their pillars ten, and their sockets ten.
verses.kjv: And for the breadth of the court on the west side shall be hangings of fifty cubits: their pillars ten, and their sockets ten.

verses.web: The breadth of the court on the east side eastward shall be fifty cubits.
verses.kjv: And the breadth of the court on the east side eastward shall be fifty cubits.

verses.web: The hangings for the one side of the gate shall be fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.
verses.kjv: The hangings of one side of the gate shall be fifteen cubits: their pillars three, and their sockets three.

verses.web: For the other side shall be hangings of fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.
verses.kjv: And on the other side shall be hangings fifteen cubits: their pillars three, and their sockets three.

verses.web: For the gate of the court shall be a screen of twenty cubits, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of the embroiderer; their pillars four, and their sockets four.
verses.kjv: And for the gate of the court shall be an hanging of twenty cubits, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, wrought with needlework: and their pillars shall be four, and their sockets four.

verses.web: All the pillars of the court around shall be filleted with silver; their hooks of silver, and their sockets of brass.
verses.kjv: All the pillars round about the court shall be filleted with silver; their hooks shall be of silver, and their sockets of brass.

verses.web: The length of the court shall be one hundred cubits, and the breadth fifty every where, and the height five cubits, of fine twined linen, and their sockets of brass.
verses.kjv: The length of the court shall be an hundred cubits, and the breadth fifty every where, and the height five cubits of fine twined linen, and their sockets of brass.

verses.web: All the instruments of the tabernacle in all its service, and all its pins, and all the pins of the court, shall be of brass.
verses.kjv: All the vessels of the tabernacle in all the service thereof, and all the pins thereof, and all the pins of the court, shall be of brass.

verses.web: “You shall command the children of Israel, that they bring to you pure olive oil beaten for the light, to cause a lamp to burn continually.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt command the children of Israel, that they bring thee pure oil olive beaten for the light, to cause the lamp to burn always.

verses.web: In the Tent of Meeting, outside the veil which is before the testimony, Aaron and his sons shall keep it in order from evening to morning before Yahweh: it shall be a statute forever throughout their generations on the behalf of the children of Israel.
verses.kjv: In the tabernacle of the congregation without the vail, which is before the testimony, Aaron and his sons shall order it from evening to morning before the Lord: it shall be a statute for ever unto their generations on the behalf of the children of Israel.

verses.web: “Bring Aaron your brother, and his sons with him, near to you from among the children of Israel, that he may minister to me in the priest’s office, even Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar, Aaron’s sons.
verses.kjv: And take thou unto thee Aaron thy brother, and his sons with him, from among the children of Israel, that he may minister unto me in the priest’s office, even Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar, Aaron’s sons.

verses.web: You shall make holy garments for Aaron your brother, for glory and for beauty.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt make holy garments for Aaron thy brother for glory and for beauty.

verses.web: You shall speak to all who are wise-hearted, whom I have filled with the spirit of wisdom, that they make Aaron’s garments to sanctify him, that he may minister to me in the priest’s office.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt speak unto all that are wise hearted, whom I have filled with the spirit of wisdom, that they may make Aaron’s garments to consecrate him, that he may minister unto me in the priest’s office.

verses.web: These are the garments which they shall make: a breastplate, and an ephod, and a robe, and a coat of checker work, a turban, and a sash: and they shall make holy garments for Aaron your brother, and his sons, that he may minister to me in the priest’s office.
verses.kjv: And these are the garments which they shall make; a breastplate, and an ephod, and a robe, and a broidered coat, a mitre, and a girdle: and they shall make holy garments for Aaron thy brother, and his sons, that he may minister unto me in the priest’s office.

verses.web: They shall take the gold, and the blue, and the purple, and the scarlet, and the fine linen.
verses.kjv: And they shall take gold, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen.

verses.web: “They shall make the ephod of gold, of blue, and purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of the skillful workman.
verses.kjv: And they shall make the ephod of gold, of blue, and of purple, of scarlet, and fine twined linen, with cunning work.

verses.web: It shall have two shoulder straps joined to the two ends of it, that it may be joined together.
verses.kjv: It shall have the two shoulderpieces thereof joined at the two edges thereof; and so it shall be joined together.

verses.web: The skillfully woven band, which is on it, that is on him, shall be like its work and of the same piece; of gold, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.
verses.kjv: And the curious girdle of the ephod, which is upon it, shall be of the same, according to the work thereof; even of gold, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.

verses.web: You shall take two onyx stones, and engrave on them the names of the children of Israel:
verses.kjv: And thou shalt take two onyx stones, and grave on them the names of the children of Israel:

verses.web: six of their names on the one stone, and the names of the six that remain on the other stone, in the order of their birth.
verses.kjv: Six of their names on one stone, and the other six names of the rest on the other stone, according to their birth.

verses.web: With the work of an engraver in stone, like the engravings of a signet, you shall engrave the two stones, according to the names of the children of Israel: you shall make them to be enclosed in settings of gold.
verses.kjv: With the work of an engraver in stone, like the engravings of a signet, shalt thou engrave the two stones with the names of the children of Israel: thou shalt make them to be set in ouches of gold.

verses.web: You shall put the two stones on the shoulder straps of the ephod, to be stones of memorial for the children of Israel: and Aaron shall bear their names before Yahweh on his two shoulders for a memorial.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt put the two stones upon the shoulders of the ephod for stones of memorial unto the children of Israel: and Aaron shall bear their names before the Lord upon his two shoulders for a memorial.

verses.web: You shall make settings of gold,
verses.kjv: And thou shalt make ouches of gold;

verses.web: and two chains of pure gold; you shall make them like cords of braided work: and you shall put the braided chains on the settings.
verses.kjv: And two chains of pure gold at the ends; of wreathen work shalt thou make them, and fasten the wreathen chains to the ouches.

verses.web: “You shall make a breastplate of judgment, the work of the skillful workman; like the work of the ephod you shall make it; of gold, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, you shall make it.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt make the breastplate of judgment with cunning work; after the work of the ephod thou shalt make it; of gold, of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, and of fine twined linen, shalt thou make it.

verses.web: It shall be square and folded double; a span shall be its length of it, and a span its breadth.
verses.kjv: Foursquare it shall be being doubled; a span shall be the length thereof, and a span shall be the breadth thereof.

verses.web: You shall set in it settings of stones, four rows of stones: a row of ruby, topaz, and beryl shall be the first row;
verses.kjv: And thou shalt set in it settings of stones, even four rows of stones: the first row shall be a sardius, a topaz, and a carbuncle: this shall be the first row.

verses.web: and the second row a turquoise, a sapphire, and an emerald;
verses.kjv: And the second row shall be an emerald, a sapphire, and a diamond.

verses.web: and the third row a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;
verses.kjv: And the third row a ligure, an agate, and an amethyst.

verses.web: and the fourth row a chrysolite, an onyx, and a jasper: they shall be enclosed in gold in their settings.
verses.kjv: And the fourth row a beryl, and an onyx, and a jasper: they shall be set in gold in their inclosings.

verses.web: The stones shall be according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names; like the engravings of a signet, everyone according to his name, they shall be for the twelve tribes.
verses.kjv: And the stones shall be with the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names, like the engravings of a signet; every one with his name shall they be according to the twelve tribes.

verses.web: You shall make on the breastplate chains like cords, of braided work of pure gold.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt make upon the breastplate chains at the ends of wreathen work of pure gold.

verses.web: You shall make on the breastplate two rings of gold, and shall put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt make upon the breastplate two rings of gold, and shalt put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate.

verses.web: You shall put the two braided chains of gold in the two rings at the ends of the breastplate.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt put the two wreathen chains of gold in the two rings which are on the ends of the breastplate.

verses.web: The other two ends of the two braided chains you shall put on the two settings, and put them on the shoulder straps of the ephod in its forepart.
verses.kjv: And the other two ends of the two wreathen chains thou shalt fasten in the two ouches, and put them on the shoulderpieces of the ephod before it.

verses.web: You shall make two rings of gold, and you shall put them on the two ends of the breastplate, on its edge, which is toward the side of the ephod inward.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt make two rings of gold, and thou shalt put them upon the two ends of the breastplate in the border thereof, which is in the side of the ephod inward.

verses.web: You shall make two rings of gold, and shall put them on the two shoulder straps of the ephod underneath, in its forepart, close by its coupling, above the skillfully woven band of the ephod.
verses.kjv: And two other rings of gold thou shalt make, and shalt put them on the two sides of the ephod underneath, toward the forepart thereof, over against the other coupling thereof, above the curious girdle of the ephod.

verses.web: They shall bind the breastplate by its rings to the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it may be on the skillfully woven band of the ephod, and that the breastplate may not swing out from the ephod.
verses.kjv: And they shall bind the breastplate by the rings thereof unto the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it may be above the curious girdle of the ephod, and that the breastplate be not loosed from the ephod.

verses.web: Aaron shall bear the names of the children of Israel in the breastplate of judgment on his heart, when he goes in to the holy place, for a memorial before Yahweh continually.
verses.kjv: And Aaron shall bear the names of the children of Israel in the breastplate of judgment upon his heart, when he goeth in unto the holy place, for a memorial before the Lord continually.

verses.web: You shall put in the breastplate of judgment the Urim and the Thummim; and they shall be on Aaron’s heart, when he goes in before Yahweh: and Aaron shall bear the judgment of the children of Israel on his heart before Yahweh continually.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt put in the breastplate of judgment the Urim and the Thummim; and they shall be upon Aaron’s heart, when he goeth in before the Lord: and Aaron shall bear the judgment of the children of Israel upon his heart before the Lord continually.

verses.web: “You shall make the robe of the ephod all of blue.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt make the robe of the ephod all of blue.

verses.web: It shall have a hole for the head in its midst: it shall have a binding of woven work around its hole, as it were the hole of a coat of mail, that it not be torn.
verses.kjv: And there shall be an hole in the top of it, in the midst thereof: it shall have a binding of woven work round about the hole of it, as it were the hole of an habergeon, that it be not rent.

verses.web: On its hem you shall make pomegranates of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, around its hem; and bells of gold between and around them:
verses.kjv: And beneath upon the hem of it thou shalt make pomegranates of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, round about the hem thereof; and bells of gold between them round about:

verses.web: a golden bell and a pomegranate, a golden bell and a pomegranate, around the hem of the robe.
verses.kjv: A golden bell and a pomegranate, a golden bell and a pomegranate, upon the hem of the robe round about.

verses.web: It shall be on Aaron to minister: and its sound shall be heard when he goes in to the holy place before Yahweh, and when he comes out, that he not die.
verses.kjv: And it shall be upon Aaron to minister: and his sound shall be heard when he goeth in unto the holy place before the Lord, and when he cometh out, that he die not.

verses.web: “You shall make a plate of pure gold, and engrave on it, like the engravings of a signet, ‘HOLY TO YAHWEH.’
verses.kjv: And thou shalt make a plate of pure gold, and grave upon it, like the engravings of a signet, HOLINESS TO THE LORD.

verses.web: You shall put it on a lace of blue, and it shall be on the sash; on the front of the sash it shall be.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt put it on a blue lace, that it may be upon the mitre; upon the forefront of the mitre it shall be.

verses.web: It shall be on Aaron’s forehead, and Aaron shall bear the iniquity of the holy things, which the children of Israel shall make holy in all their holy gifts; and it shall be always on his forehead, that they may be accepted before Yahweh.
verses.kjv: And it shall be upon Aaron’s forehead, that Aaron may bear the iniquity of the holy things, which the children of Israel shall hallow in all their holy gifts; and it shall be always upon his forehead, that they may be accepted before the Lord.

verses.web: You shall weave the coat in checker work of fine linen, and you shall make a turban of fine linen, and you shall make a sash, the work of the embroiderer.
